# Continuing with the Plane Crash Info Example
```{r}
year = 2025

crash_url = paste0('https://www.planecrashinfo.com/', year, '/', year, '.htm')

crash_page <- rvest::read_html(crash_url, encoding = "ISO-8859-1")

# This should now print without the error
crash_page

# How many <table> elements are on the page?
crash_tables <- crash_page |>
  rvest::html_elements("table") |>
  rvest::html_table()

# From a cleaning perspective:
  # Translate this into a pdf 
  # Replace the current headers with row 1 then delete row 1
  # Convert date into a date column instead a character
  # more complex cleaning to split multiple information within a cell into separate columns  (not happening in today's class-- but try AI)

# using brackets to access df
crash_df = crash_tables[[1]] # subsetting a list

# assign column names
colnames(crash_df) = c(crash_df$X1[1], crash_df$X2[1], crash_df$X3[1], crash_df$X4[1])

# drop first row
crash_df = crash_df[-1, 1:4] # delete row 1 and keep columns 1:4 (since no negative) (or leave it blank)

# convert date column into a date type object
crash_df = crash_df |> 
  dplyr::mutate(Date = lubridate::dmy(Date))

dplyr::glimpse(crash_df)
```

# Practice Salvage Run

```{r}
page = rvest::read_html("https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app/registry?start=1")
classes = page |>
  rvest::html_elements(".Dreadnought") |>
  rvest::html_text2()
length(classes)   # check this first: one per card
```
```{r}
base = "https://isa401-salvage.vercel.app"
starts = seq(from = 1, to = 351, by = 50)
pages = vector("list", length(starts)) # initializing the list (similar to initializing the df)

for (i in seq_along(starts)) {
  pg = rvest::read_html(paste0(base, "/registry?start=", starts[i]))
  pages[[i]] = data.frame(
    class = pg |> 
      rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(1) > span") |> # corresponds to the first row (telling us the class), you can copy the path like this or use `.ship-class`
      rvest::html_text2(),
    value = pg |> 
      rvest::html_elements("div > ul > li:nth-child(3) > span") |> # corresponds to the third row (telling us the est. salvage), you can copy the path like this or use `.salvage-value`
      rvest::html_text2() |> 
      readr::parse_number()
  )
  Sys.sleep(1)   # robots.txt asks for it
}
registry = dplyr::bind_rows(pages)   # 400 rows?

dreadnought_df = registry |> 
  dplyr::filter(class=="Dreadnought")

sum(dreadnought_df$value)
```
